Public capability-discovery surface (P41). Returns 200 with no credential of any kind; p41-handlers.js reads no auth header, tier or API key, so the body is identical for every caller. index.js dispatches it OUTSIDE the _p17to40Gated auth regex by explicit design, so no authenticated variant exists. PUBLIC_CATEGORIES hard-filters server-side to CUSTOMER_UI -- ADMIN/INTERNAL/DEPRECATED can never leave the route. Page-inventory metadata only (id/title/frontend_route/status), never intelligence data. Lists the public capability inventory; the optional ?status= filter narrows that same public set.
